q1.explanationZh: gracious 作形容词“亲切的；慈祥的”，Goodness gracious! 是感叹语“天哪”。

q2.explanationZh: grade 名词“年级；成绩”，动词“批改；分级”。

q3.explanationZh: gradual 形容词“逐渐的”，加 -ly 变副词 gradually。

q4.explanationZh: gradual 加 -ly 构成副词 gradually“逐渐地”。

q5.explanationZh: graduate 名词“毕业生”，动词“毕业”，graduate from“从……毕业”。

q6.explanationZh: graduate 的名词形式是 graduation“毕业”。

q9.explanationZh: “克”英式拼写 gramme，美式拼写 gram，两种都对。

q10.explanationZh: grand 形容词“宏伟的；主要的”，侧重规模大。

q11.explanationZh: grand + daughter = granddaughter“（外）孙女”，注意中间有两个 d。

q12.explanationZh: grand + father = grandfather“（外）祖父”，口语说 grandpa。

q13.explanationZh: grand + mother = grandmother“（外）祖母”，口语说 grandma。

q16.explanationZh: grant 动词“同意；授予”，名词“授予物”，take sth. for granted“认为理所当然”。

q18.explanationZh: grasp 可作名词和动词，“抓住；理解”。

q20.explanationZh: grateful 形容词“感激的”，be grateful to sb. for sth.。

q21.explanationZh: gratitude 名词“感激之情”，是 grateful 的名词形式。

q22.explanationZh: grave 有两个同形词：名词“墓穴”和形容词“严重的；严肃的”，拼写相同。

q23.explanationZh: gravity 名词“重力；引力”，也可表示“严肃，严重”。

q24.explanationZh: great 形容词“伟大的；巨大的”，口语中表示“太好了”。

q25.explanationZh: greedy 形容词“贪婪的”，be greedy for“贪图……”。

q26.explanationZh: green 形容词“绿色的”，名词“绿色；公共草地”。

q27.explanationZh: green + house = greenhouse“温室”，greenhouse effect“温室效应”。

q28.explanationZh: greet 是及物动词“问候；打招呼”，后面直接接人。

q29.explanationZh: greet 加 -ing 构成名词 greeting“问候”。

q30.explanationZh: grey“灰色（的）”，英式拼写 grey，美式 gray。

q31.explanationZh: grief 名词“悲伤”，注意 ie 的顺序。

q32.explanationZh: grill 名词“烤架”，动词“（在烤架上）烤”，结尾双写 l。

q34.explanationZh: ground“地面；场地”，复数 grounds 常表示“理由”。

q35.explanationZh: group 名词“组；团体”，动词“聚集；分组”。

accept: grant sth. to sb. (= grant sb. sth.)

q36.explanationZh: “同意某人某事”= grant sth. to sb. = grant sb. sth.。

q37.explanationZh: take it for granted that...“认为……理所当然”，it 是形式宾语；也可说 take sth. for granted。

q38.explanationZh: beyond one’s grasp“够不着；理解不了”，beyond 表示“超出”。

q39.explanationZh: within one’s grasp“够得着；能理解”，within 表示“在……范围内”。

q40.explanationZh: grasp at“设法抓住”，介词用 at。

accept: be grateful to sb. for sth.

q41.explanationZh: be grateful to sb. for sth.：感激某人用 to，因为某事用 for。

q42.explanationZh: “操场”= playground，写成一个词。书上印作 play ground，经人工复核（GitHub #136）更正为 playground。

q44.explanationZh: be greedy for“贪图……”，介词用 for。

q45.explanationZh: greet sb. with a nod“向某人点头致意”，nod 是“点头”。

q46.explanationZh: greet 也可表示“迎接”，greet the New Year“迎接新年”。

q47.explanationZh: grey-white“灰白色的”，中间用连字符。

q48.explanationZh: a group of“一群；一批”，后接复数名词。

q49.explanationZh: 谚语 Grasp all, lose all.“什么都想抓，结果全失去”，即“贪多必失”。

q50.explanationZh: in the second grade“上二年级”，grade 表示“年级”。

q51.explanationZh: was 后需要形容词，gracious“亲切的”；adj. + enough to do“足够……去做”。

q52.explanationZh: 1/1000 千克是“1 克”，A 后用单数 gram（英式 gramme）。

q53.explanationZh: 谓语是 are，主语要用复数 grandparents“祖父母”。

q54.explanationZh: fail to do 后接动词原形，grasp“理解；抓住”。

q55.explanationZh: be covered with grass“长满了草”，grass 不可数。

q56.explanationZh: 介词 after 后接动名词，graduate from“从……毕业”→ graduating。

q58.explanationZh: take it for granted that...的被动形式 It’s taken for granted that...“……被认为理所当然”。

q59.explanationZh: group 作动词“使聚集”，主语是单数，一般现在时用 groups。

q60.explanationZh: be grateful to sb. for sth.“为某事感激某人”。

q61.sampleAnswer: The farmer received a grant of land from the government.
references: The farmer received a grant of land from the government.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: grant 作名词“授予物”，a grant of land“一块（被授予的）土地”；“领受”用 receive。

q62.sampleAnswer: You should study hard to have a good grasp of English.
references: You should study hard to have a good grasp of English.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “精通”可用 have a good grasp of sth.，grasp 作名词“理解，掌握”。

q63.sampleAnswer: I owe a debt of gratitude to her.
references: I owe a debt of gratitude to her.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “万分感激”= owe a (big) debt of gratitude to sb.，字面是“欠某人一份感激之情”。

q64.sampleAnswer: Contrary to our estimation, the unexpected accident didn’t lead to great losses.
references: Contrary to our estimation, the unexpected accident didn’t lead to great losses.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “与……相反”= contrary to；“造成”= lead to；“巨大的损失”= great losses。

q65.sampleAnswer: Every time he recalls the happy moments he spent with his grandmother in his childhood, he can’t help feeling warm inside.
references: Every time he recalls the happy moments he spent with his grandmother in his childhood, he can’t help feeling warm inside.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “每每”= every time 引导时间状语；“情不自禁地做”= can’t help doing。

q66.sampleAnswer: There is a saying that great hopes make great men.
references: There is a saying that great hopes make great men.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “有句谚语”= There is a saying that...；谚语原文是 Great hopes make great men.，men 用复数。答案书印作 great man，经人工复核（GitHub #136）更正为 great men。

q67.sampleAnswer: As night fell, small groups of residents gathered in the park to do some exercise.
references: As night fell, small groups of residents gathered in the park to do some exercise.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “三五成群的”可译为 small groups of；“夜幕降临”= as night fell。

q68.sampleAnswer: When you first meet the interviewer, greet him or her politely.
references: When you first meet the interviewer, greet him or her politely.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: greet 是及物动词，“向某人打招呼”= greet sb.，主句是祈使句。

q69.sampleAnswer: After listening to the professor’s inspiring lecture, more university graduates are willing to devote themselves to the cause of environmental protection.
references: After listening to the professor’s inspiring lecture, more university graduates are willing to devote themselves to the cause of environmental protection.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “大学毕业生”= university graduates，这里用复数；“投身于”= devote oneself to，to 是介词。

q70.sampleAnswer: Because people hold a firm belief that food is vital for man’s health, good cooks are always making efforts to maintain balance between grain, meat and vegetables.
references: Because people hold a firm belief that food is vital for man’s health, good cooks are always making efforts to maintain balance between grain, meat and vegetables.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “坚信”= hold a firm belief that...；“至关重要的”= vital；“取得平衡”= maintain balance between...。答案书印作 blance，是拼写错误，经人工复核（GitHub #136）更正为 balance。
